pr_title: streamingccl: fix nil linter check error and stream_ingestion_test error
pr_body:
Previously, the stream ingestion test has no error since no
duplicate event is generated. This PR fixes this and nil linter
check error at the same time.

Release note: None
Closes: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/79926

Related to https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/79929 which 
disables random_stream_client nil linter check. Will re-enable it after it's 
merged.
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/79935)

issue_context.title: streamclient: suspect code in `random_stream_client.go`
issue_context.body:
In my testing the `nilness` linter flagged this line of code in `random_stream_client.go`:

```
					if rng.Float64() < config.dupProbability && keyValCopy != nil {
```

The problem being that it is impossible for `keyValCopy` to be non-`nil` at this point. It is declared on line 374 and is not updated prior to this check. It is later set on line 398 and read from (without a nilness check?) on line 410. This code should be updated at least so it does not trigger any `nilness` check errors.

Jira issue: CRDB-15724

review_comments: perhaps are apis are not good? I don't understand why we need a copy of a copy...
